'''Reggie Jackson''' (born April 16, 1990) is an American [[college basketball]] player for the [[Boston College]] [[Boston College Basketball|Eagles men's basketball]] team.<ref>http://bceagles.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/jackson_reggie00.html</ref>  As a junior, he led the Eagles in scoring for the [[2010-11 Boston College Eagles men's basketball team|2010-11]] season with 18.2 points per game.<ref>http://bceagles.cstv.com/auto_pdf/p_hotos/s_chools/bc/sports/m-baskbl/auto_pdf/cumulative-stats</ref>  Jackson was named to the All-ACC First team for the 2010-11 season, along with [[Nolan Smith]], [[Jordan Williams]], [[Malcolm Delaney]], and [[Kyle Singler]].<ref>http://www.newsobserver.com/2011/03/07/1036739/dukes-smith-singler-named-first.html</ref>  As a senior at [[General William J. Palmer High School|Palmer High School]] in Colorado, Jackson won the 2007-08 Gatorade Colorado Boys Basketball Player of the Year.<ref>http://www.gazettepreps.com/sports/jackson-694-basketball-palmer.html</ref>
